entities.summary: Carndochan Castle is a ruined stone castle near Llanuwchllyn, Gwynedd, north Wales. It was probably built in the early thirteenth century and is a Scheduled Ancient Monument. Carndochan Castle is a archaeological site from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
